agent.reasons: The entity and its 67% owner and control person, Yusuf Zhou, are both located in Vietnam. Vietnam is on the FATF increased-monitoring list, so 6.2 requires escalation to EDD. Two request-documents items also apply: Ember Holdings LLC holds 33% and its owners are unknown, so ownership is incomplete (3.3), and the registry filing dated 2025-06-16 is more than 12 months old at review (3.5). Under 2.1, escalation is the more severe outcome and governs.
still_needed: Beneficial owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33% holder), or proof that it is an excluded entity
Current registry filing less than 12 months old
Confirmation that Vietnam is still on the FATF increased-monitoring list as of 2026-10-27
